mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM CONSUMPTION_ANALYSIS_RESULTS ORDER BY user_id

SELECT analysis_result_id AS analysisResultId, user_id AS userId, calculated_result AS calculatedResultJson FROM CONSUMPTION_ANALYSIS_RESULTS WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY generated_at DESC, analysis_result_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT mission_cycle_id AS missionCycleId, user_id AS userId, cycle_start_date AS cycleStartDate, cycle_end_date AS cycleEndDate, status, source_analysis_result_id AS sourceAnalysisResultId, prompt_version AS promptVersion, generation_error AS generationError, generated_at AS generatedAt FROM MISSION_CYCLES WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cycle_start_date = #{cycleStartDate}

SELECT mission_cycle_id AS missionCycleId, user_id AS userId, cycle_start_date AS cycleStartDate, cycle_end_date AS cycleEndDate, status, source_analysis_result_id AS sourceAnalysisResultId, prompt_version AS promptVersion, generation_error AS generationError, generated_at AS generatedAt FROM MISSION_CYCLES WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND cycle_start_date = #{cycleStartDate} FOR UPDATE
SELECT user_id FROM MISSION_CYCLES WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND #{assignedDate} BETWEEN cycle_start_date AND cycle_end_date ORDER BY user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE MISSION_CYCLES SET status = #{status}, generation_error = #{generationError}, generated_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'ACTIVE' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE generated_at END WHERE mission_cycle_id = #{missionCycleId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MISSIONS WHERE mission_cycle_id = #{missionCycleId}

SELECT mission_id AS missionId, mission_cycle_id AS missionCycleId, title, description, category, difficulty, reward_point AS rewardPoint, verification_type AS verificationType, verification_rule AS verificationRuleJson, evidence_guide AS evidenceGuide, deduplication_key AS deduplicationKey FROM MISSIONS WHERE mission_cycle_id = #{missionCycleId} ORDER BY mission_id

SELECT daily.daily_mission_id AS dailyMissionId, daily.mission_cycle_id AS missionCycleId, daily.mission_id AS missionId, daily.user_id AS userId, daily.assigned_date AS assignedDate, daily.display_order AS displayOrder, daily.status, daily.completed_at AS completedAt, mission.title, mission.description, mission.category, mission.difficulty, mission.reward_point AS rewardPoint, mission.verification_type AS verificationType, mission.evidence_guide AS evidenceGuide FROM DAILY_MISSIONS daily JOIN MISSIONS mission ON mission.mission_id = daily.mission_id WHERE daily.user_id = #{userId} AND daily.assigned_date = #{assignedDate} ORDER BY daily.display_order
